name: DS18B20Sensor
description: One DS18B20-compatible 1-Wire temperature sensor for ESP32, ESP8266 and AVR (Arduino). Reads by ROM address after a broadcast conversion, keeps DallasTemperature's raw error codes apart (power-on reset, insufficient power, disconnected, out of range), identifies genuine Maxim parts and clones via CheckDS18B20, and offers CRC-checked address parsing and a one-call status copy. No dynamic allocation; host-testable.
keywords: ds18b20, ds18s20, ds1822, max31850, onewire, 1-wire, temperature, sensor, clone
